text:
alex.support: Customer on prod seeing streaming responses cut off ~2-3s in, sometimes followed by a 401. They reported one request id: rqd-20260317-9f2b6a. Happens after token rotation window. Can we get a minimal repro checklist and curl they can run?

maria_escalations: got it. Can you paste full request id + model + region + auth type? also whether they see any client-side errors.

alex.support: request id: rqd-20260317-9f2b6a
model: redwood-13b-8k
region: us-west-2
auth: short-lived bearer issued by our edge proxy (rotates every 5m)
client: Windows 10, curl 7.83, behind corporate proxy

alex.support: here is the curl they tried (they said simple):
```bash
curl -N "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-8k","input":"hello"}'
```

ryan_infra: quick suggestions — ask them to run with --no-buffer and --raw and capture a trace-ascii so we can see headers and chunk framing. Minimal reproducer I usually send:
```bash
curl --no-buffer --raw --trace-ascii /tmp/trace.txt \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-13b-8k" \
  -d '{"input":"test streaming\\nline2"}'
```

ryan_infra: Also have them capture stdout/stderr redirect to files, e.g. `curl ... > /tmp/out.txt 2> /tmp/err.txt` and attach /tmp/trace.txt. If behind corp proxy, ask them to include proxy logs or at least confirm the proxy type.

maria_escalations: checklist for support bundle (send this list):
1) curl --no-buffer --raw --trace-ascii output file
2) raw curl stdout/stderr (files)
3) full request id(s) and local timestamps (ISO 8601)
4) model, region, route/path used
5) client OS, curl version, proxy/CDN in between
6) whether auth rotated during the request (approx ts)
7) tcpdump/pcap of the session if allowed (or at least proxy logs)

alex.support: customer asked what exact headers to include in repro. any extras we want them to try?

ryan_infra: try forcing `Connection: keep-alive` and `Accept: text/event-stream`. Also try adding `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` header if their proxy rewrites TE. If they can reproduce without proxy (direct from home laptop) that's huge for narrowing scope.

sam_agentbot: deploy-bot: Deployed inference-service v2.14 to us-west-2 (2026-03-17T09:10Z)

maria_escalations: thanks — infra already flagged a recent gateway change that touched transfer-encoding handling. We're investigating but please still collect the bundle. If they can reproduce, attach request id so we can correlate server traces.

alex.support: I'll send the checklist and the enhanced curl snippet. Will update when they post the trace files. :thumbsup:

maria_escalations: if they can't reproduce locally, ask for a small reproducible script that does many short streaming requests in a loop — sometimes the token rotation race only shows up under repeated attempts. Also ask for the exact token expiry window.

alex.support: noted. pushing checklist now to customer. Will follow up with the files here once available.
